correctness.rationale: Affine conjugation gives g(X)=X^2+kappa/4 and f^(k)(gamma)=(2*g^(k)(0)-b)/(2a). The three orbit lists are constant 0, alternating -1/0, and -2 followed by constant 2. The coefficient-wise square tests follow by substitution. For irreducible kappa=-4, simultaneous odd/even squares force b(b+2) an integer square and (b+1)^2-w^2=1, hence b=0 or -2 and square discriminant. For kappa=-8, simultaneous values imply b^2-w^2=16; the only integer possibilities b=+-4,+-5 are incompatible with integrality or irreducibility. Reconstructed 556 integral coefficient boundary cases and twelve critical iterates with exact Fractions; no counterexample.
residual_risks: This verifies only the three explicitly nonwandering families; no claim for wandering critical orbits.
